sentences.text: This is the FIRST bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

The applicant is in custody since 25-09-2022 in connection with Crime No.289 of 2021 registered at Police Station City Kotwali, District Bhind for offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC and Section 66-D of IT Act.

Allegation against the present applicant along with another co-accused person is that they have committed fraud and cheating with complainant Sweta Tomar and her friends by extracting money Soniya @ Pallavi Sonobal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150474852/
1 of Rs.4,95,000/- dishonestly by way of making preparation of forged ATM Card, UPI number and Google pay.
It is submitted by counsel for the applicant as well as the complainant that a compromise has been arrived at between the applicant and complainant.

entities.text: Soniya @ Pallavi Sonobal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The complainant has got refunded the alleged amount from the applicant.
In this regard, an application under Section 320 of CrPC along with affidavit of complainant has been filed.
Learned Public Prosecutor for the State formally opposed the application and prayed for its dismissal.
Heard learned counsel for both the parties.

Looking to the the facts and circumstances of this case as well as the fact that since compromise has been arrived at between the applicant- accused and complainant, but without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes a fresh bail bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five thousand only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court, she should be released on bail.
She will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE MKB Soniya @ Pallavi Sonobal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150474852/
